charge_port.notes: Estimated: The Charge Port US checker lists Polestar 3 (2025-2026) as CCS1 with a paid adapter; Polestar US page lists a Type 1 AC cable and says the car is compatible with the NACS adapter, which a native NACS port would not need. Canada: Polestar Canada page also names the NACS adapter.

supercharger_access.notes: Polestar US: "Polestar 2, Polestar 3 and Polestar 4 vehicles are compatible with the NACS adapter" (bought at a Service Point; $230 per InsideEVs).
Polestar Canada: same statement for Polestar 2, 3 and 4.
